title: Visualization Facet
description: SDD-R011 §13. Presentation hints only -- never changes engineering meaning. Raw asset files (icons, previews, 3D models, footprints) moved to the Asset Facet (assets.schema.json) as of WORK_PACKAGE_002; this facet references them by role name, not by path, keeping 'which files this object owns' and 'how to present them' independently evolvable (SDD-R011 §19).

color_hints.description: Free-form role -> color hint map (e.g. {"body": "#c8a165"}). Advisory only.

asset_roles.description: Role names (matching assets.yaml's `role` field) this object actually uses for presentation, e.g. ["icon", "symbol"].
